card.name: Words just before 'regardless of' phrasing
card.fires_on: Words where the next likely words are 'with or without' or 'regardless of', mainly 'can' or 'time' in 'These serious adverse events can occur at any time'. Also seen on a word that sets up an unconditional statement.

modes.label: NSAID warning sentence
modes.description: 'can' or 'time' inside 'serious adverse events can occur at any time, with or without warning'.
modes.example: These serious adverse events<< can>> occur at any time, with or without

modes.label: Unconditional statements
modes.description: A word that leads into a claim that holds whatever the circumstances.
modes.example: if one particle has a spin ‘up’ then the other<< automatically>> has a spin ‘down’.

card.writes: It promotes 'regardless' and 'irrespective' in English and Chinese, pushing toward 'whatever the condition' wording.
card.plain: It fires where the text is about to say something happens regardless of other conditions.
